comparison.objective: Closes an edge joint and builds force by pumping a one-hand bar-clamp trigger; the candidate calibrates and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-771 requires placing jaws around boards and repeated trigger strokes through a ratchet mechanism; the candidate requires precise hex-driver and thin-wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-771 checks joint closure, board alignment, at least 20 N clamping force, released stillness, and clear hands; the candidate checks angular accuracy and cycle retention.
comparison.reason: Both retain a mechanical setting after release, but force-producing ratchet clamping does not test coupled threaded setpoint locking.
